alex_k: Heads-up — apples-to-apples compare (replay + synth) shows a ~12% P95 regression for model-v2 vs yesterday. digging.
maria_r: Oof. Which harness/workload? replay or synthetic?
alex_k: Both. Replay (customer-100k shortchat) p95 420ms -> 470ms. Synth (prefix-reuse) shows similar delta.
ben_s: Any kernel selection diffs? I think the last rollout flipped the kernel-picker weights to prefer v1_fused on short sequences.
sophia_t: I suspected that. v1_fused increases KV cache churn for repeated prefixes. Try forcing fallback kernel to confirm.
alex_k: Repro steps I ran:
```
# baseline
./tools/run_compare --harness replay --workload customer-100k --seed 123 \
  --model model-v2 --decode-params decode.json --metric p95
# force fallback
KERNEL_FORCE=fallback ./tools/run_compare --harness replay --workload customer-100k ...
```
Baseline p95: 470ms
Forced fallback p95: 415ms
So forcing fallback restores previous numbers.
maria_r: That points at kernel selection + KV behavior. Any profiler traces?
jamie_p: Uploading trace: https://perf.reports/2796543210/trace (main thread). Hotspots: `kv_read_shard` + increased `context_serialize` time.
ci-bot: CI job 2796543209 completed — synthetic perf smoke OK, but CI doesn't run apples parity by default.
sophia_t: Also check tokenizer/stop sequences. If tokenization drifted we could be decoding more tokens per prompt.
alex_k: Token counts are identical across runs; stop sequences unchanged. KV miss rate is the big delta — miss ratio up ~18%.
ben_s: Note we also tweaked batching heuristics last week: host-tier wait window increased from 8ms -> 18ms to favor larger batches. That _helps_ throughput but can worsen short-chat p95.
maria_r: So two orthogonal regressions: kernel-picker prefers a kernel with worse KV locality, and batching wait change hurts latency on short requests.
sophia_t: Short-term mitigation ideas:
- pin kernel selection for short_seq <= 64 to `fallback` (no fused kernel)
- revert host-tier batching wait to 8ms until we evaluate impact
- add KV-miss assertions to apples harness
ben_s: Agree. Medium-term: update kernel picker cost model to include a KV-miss penalty term and incorporate recent perf telemetry.
alex_k: I'll open a small PR to add an opt-in flag `--prefer-fallback-on-short` and add a config to the harness to assert KV-miss delta < 5% vs baseline.
jamie_p: :thumbsup: Please also add the perf trace link + p95 numbers to the PR description.
alex_k: Quick paste of the minimal reproducer config I used:
```
{
  "harness": "replay",
  "workload": "customer-100k",
  "seed": 123,
  "model": "model-v2",
  "decode": {"temp": 0.0, "stop": ["\n\n"]},
  "metrics": ["p50","p95","kv_miss_rate"]
}
```
maria_r: Nice. Also recommend running synth replay with `--prefix-reuse` and track batch sizes distribution.
alex_k: Ran that too — average batch size rose slightly, but tail saw more single-request batches due to early waits; batch distribution shifted causing less effective KV reuse.
sophia_t: Action items: (1) PR to pin fallback on short sequences, (2) revert host-tier wait, (3) add KV-miss + token-count guards to apples harness, (4) update kernel-picker cost model RFC (medium-term).
alex_k: I'll do (1)-(3) today, open RFC for (4) tomorrow and post benchmarks.
ben_s: If you need a quick knob I can expose kernel-picker weight as runtime param for A/B tests.
jamie_p: :eyes: Also consider adding a small synthetic test that toggles kernel pref vs kv_miss to show tradeoff curves.
alex_k: Will attach perf summary to the PR. Preliminary: fallback + revert = ~2% improvement vs baseline and restores parity with previous day's run. I'll update thread with final numbers.
maria_r: Great. Thanks for the triage. Keep us posted. :party_parrot:
